GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (11 Jan 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1459)
APO 500
11 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Discontinuance of Aeronautical Radio Facilities.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, File AG 676.3 (31 Jul 46)CCS (SCAPIN-1095), subject: Discontinuance of Aeronautical Radio Facilities.
b. Central Liaison Office Memorandum Number 6658(CC) dated 14 December 1946, subject: Discontinuance of Aeronautical Radio Facilities.
2. The subject transmitters referred to in paragraph 3 of referenced memorandum cited in paragraph 1b above, will be released to the Home Ministry by Eighth Army for proper disposition in accordance with existing regulations.
3. The Home Ministry is authorized to release the subject transmitters for use at the radio stations indicated for the purposes outlined in paragraph 3 of referenced memorandum cited in paragraph 1b above. These transmitters are part of the equipment which has been dismantled as directed in referenced memorandum cited in paragraph 1a above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
